clips.title: The story
paras: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar races to brew a cure for the poisoned hunter Rhinag. You gather venomtail poison sacs from scorpids outside the city walls before their venom proves fatal. Durotar's wildlife is unforgiving, and survival depends on wilderness preparation.

Rhinag, a Darkspear troll, was hunting in Durotar when he faced venomtail scorpids without an antidote. Their potent venom struck quickly, leaving him in need of immediate aid. Kor'ghan, an experienced hunter in Orgrimmar, must mix a draught before the poison kills him.

Mature venomtail scorpids outside Orgrimmar's gates carry the sacs Kor'ghan needs to make an antidote. He says there will be time to chastise Rhinag for going unprepared, but every moment matters now. Bring the sacs back into the city, and Kor'ghan can brew the draught for the dying hunter.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.
Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.
Make haste, friend. One of our own needs your help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. That knowledge could save your life.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is the antidote, friend. Take it to Rhinag as soon as you can, and be cautious.
